def categorize_time_of_day(hour):
    """Categorize hour into time of day
    morning: 6:00 to 11:59 (hours 6 to 11)
    afternoon: 12:00 to 17:59 (hours 12 to 17)
    evening: 18:00 to 23:59 (hours 18 to 23)
    night: 0:00 to 5:59 (hours 0 to 5)
    """
    if 6 <= hour < 12:  # morning: 6 to 11
        return 'morning'
    elif 12 <= hour < 18:  # afternoon: 12 to 17
        return 'afternoon'
    elif 18 <= hour < 24:  # evening: 18 to 23
        return 'evening'
    else:  # night: 0 to 5
        return 'night'

# Apply the corrected categorization
df['time_of_day'] = df['hour'].apply(categorize_time_of_day)
